title: Concept: LDAP filter built by concatenation (python) — review required
description: In python, conn.search(base, f"(uid={u})") mixes filter syntax with values. LDAP metacharacters (*, (, ), \) in input alter which entries match. The remedy is value escaping via ldap3.utils.conv escape_filter_chars.
applicability: python codebases querying directories with assembled filters; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Authentication bypass and directory disclosure; HIGH severity for login paths.
